scope: tracked representative APIs and milestone contracts; not full Apple iOS 27 API or firmware inventory

status_definitions.native-fixture: real ARM64 machine code, compiler-produced or reviewed synthetic fixture with native execution; NOT Apple app compatibility
status_definitions.synthetic: host-side parsing/model or synthetic probe tested in repo; NOT a shipped Apple framework export
status_definitions.excluded: outside project safety/architecture scope, never counted implemented

ceiling_definitions.plausible: feasible for a limited userspace subset, not guaranteed generally
ceiling_definitions.conditional: likely requires a new trustworthy subsystem and on-device validation
ceiling_definitions.unknown: feasibility of official Apple behavior has not been established

panels.title: system libraries / api targets
panels.subtitle: representative abi/function contracts, NOT an exhaustive apple export database

panels.title: darwin runtime / native compatibility
panels.subtitle: narrow tests, parser contracts and mach models; NOT general ios execution

panels.title: apple ui / android integration
panels.subtitle: official framework and system ui dependencies; feasibility mostly unproven

groups.label: libsystem_kernel / bsd
groups.note: selected xnu bsd calls can be translated, but guest ownership, cancellation, darwin errno, rights and file isolation need proof. only seven syscall probe selectors currently work in a tiny interpreter, not as linked libsystem exports.

groups.label: libsystem_c / libc
groups.note: portable c functions could be implemented or safely forwarded after abi and guest address-space isolation; these are representative targets, not extracted iphone exports.

groups.label: libsystem_pthread
groups.note: darwin thread startup, tls, signals, cancellation and workqueues require more than linux pthread wrappers.

groups.label: libdispatch / gdc
groups.note: dispatch object ownership and queues may be portable, but apple qos, workqueue and runloop integration need dedicated tests.

groups.label: libdyld / dynamic loading
groups.note: mapped native fixtures do not export a compatible libdyld ABI to unmodified apple programs.

groups.label: libobjc / objc runtime
groups.note: open objc runtimes provide a possible research starting point; apple objc abi and arm64e dispatch are not validated here.

groups.label: Swift runtime / ABI
groups.note: these are selected swift runtime contract families rather than exact mangled exports; true swift abi interoperability is absent.

groups.label: CoreFoundation
groups.note: apple corefoundation binaries and exact cf ownership/event-loop behavior have not run; targets are representative public functions.

groups.label: Foundation / classes
groups.note: selected class contracts, not every foundation method or real symbols. apple foundation loading has not been demonstrated.

groups.label: Security / keychain
groups.note: keychain, signing, attestation and entitlements rely on an apple-specific trust model that the android host does not provide.

groups.label: CFNetwork / Network.framework
groups.note: the network path may use android transports through an isolated proxy; authentic apple policy and entitlement behavior is unproven.

groups.label: mach-o parser and native loader
groups.note: merged phase18a demonstrates bounded LC_MAIN argv/envp and a guarded guest stack for reviewed SDK-free ARM64 fixtures. no general Darwin process, TLS initialization, syscall integration, fault containment, or sandbox exists.

groups.label: dyld / image graph
groups.note: merged phase18b proves bounded native 3-dylib graphs and explicit guest-path @rpath resolution with no host filesystem fallback. only a dependency-first initializer plan exists; no automatic constructors, Apple dyld cache, or arm64e.

targets.name: special ordinal binding and dependency finalizer plan

groups.label: mach ipc model
groups.note: phase18c adds synthetic task-local port sets, bounded 128-byte single OOL descriptors and sequence trailers; all operations are synchronous fixture calls, not kernel Mach traps, audit tokens, full OOL VM or entitlement-aware processes.

targets.name: task-local thread identity and stale-handle rejection

groups.label: bsd syscall boundary
groups.note: a narrow interpreter responds to six identity calls plus a virtual exit, not general darwin syscalls from native processes.

groups.label: arm64e and abi compatibility
groups.note: native aarch64 is not proof of arm64e abi; authenticated pointer formats are deliberately rejected rather than bypassed.

groups.label: guest security / isolation
groups.note: the current reviewed fixture runner executes in-process. boot chain writes and weakening selinux are explicitly excluded.

groups.label: UIKit / controls
groups.note: official apple framework code, event dispatch and rendering are not working. all entries are target contracts, not sdk export enumeration.

groups.label: SwiftUI / view graph
groups.note: genuine swiftui binaries and dynamic view graph machinery have not run.

groups.label: CoreAnimation / compositor
groups.note: renderer compatibility requires apple semantics converted into isolated android-compatible surfaces.

groups.label: Metal / IOSurface / gpu
groups.note: apple metal command and resource semantics are not a one-to-one vulkan translation; apple iosurface ownership is not present.

groups.label: SpringBoard / apple services
groups.note: genuine apple private processes, entitlements and dependencies are untested on this phone.

groups.label: iOS apps / app services
groups.note: legitimate ios binaries still depend on dyld, frameworks, entitlements and security. no unrestricted app execution is demonstrated.

groups.label: Android host integration
groups.note: any bridge should remain voluntary, non-root and not alter android recovery or verified boot.

groups.label: device boot and kernel ownership
groups.note: full ios kernel or flash-based ios replacement is not a deliverable under the hard no-boot-chain-change constraints; excluded blocks are never counted as working.

groups.label: ObjC host prototype (not Apple libobjc)

catalog_policy: Status changes require reviewed explicit evidence and matching tests; the live refresh only updates source provenance.
